_doc: Set 'platform' to discord, teams, or slack. Configure the matching section below. Member IDs are platform-specific: Discord = numeric user ID, Teams = AAD Object ID (GUID), Slack = member ID (Uxxxxxxxx).
_threshold_note: Fraction of quorum required for majority. 0.5 = strictly >50%. For 3 members: 2 votes needed. For 5 members: 3 votes needed.
_deadlineHours_note: Hours before an unresolved vote closes as EXPIRED (DENIED, fail-closed).

_platform_configs._note: Only the block matching your chosen 'platform' value is used. Set credentials via GitHub Secrets, not here.

discord._member_id_format: Numeric user ID — Developer Mode → right-click username → Copy User ID
discord._voting_mechanism: Bot seeds ✅ ❌ reactions; engine polls GET /reactions every 30 s

teams._member_id_format: Azure AD Object ID (GUID) — Azure Portal → Users → select user → Object ID
teams._voting_mechanism: Adaptive Card with Action.Submit buttons; votes POST to TEAMS_VOTE_WEBHOOK_URL
teams._vote_endpoint_note: TEAMS_VOTE_WEBHOOK_URL must be a publicly reachable HTTPS endpoint (Azure Function, Logic App, or ngrok tunnel for testing). It receives POST {quorum_id, vote, member_id, member_name} and should respond 200 with {type:'message', text:'Vote recorded'}.
teams._vote_server_note: The engine also starts a local HTTP server on VOTE_SERVER_PORT (default 3000) to receive vote callbacks directly when running in an environment where the runner is reachable.

slack._member_id_format: Slack member ID — click profile → More → Copy member ID (starts with U)
slack._voting_mechanism: Block Kit message with primary/danger buttons; votes POST to SLACK_VOTE_WEBHOOK_URL via Slack interactivity
slack._vote_endpoint_note: SLACK_VOTE_WEBHOOK_URL must match your Slack app's Interactivity Request URL. The engine starts a local HTTP server on VOTE_SERVER_PORT (default 3000) to receive these callbacks.
slack._confirm_dialogs: Both ✅ and ❌ buttons show a confirmation dialog before submitting — prevents accidental votes.

_env_overrides._note: Any field can be overridden at runtime via environment variables without changing this file.
_env_overrides.VOTE_SERVER_PORT: Integer port for Teams/Slack vote callback server (default 3000)

namedRoles._note: Maps policy.yaml role names to platform-specific member IDs. Used by policy-as-code for required member enforcement.
